title: fetch_session: unnecessary url::Url→String conversion
description: fetch_session calls base_url.join(...).to_string() then passes &url_string to http.get(). reqwest::Client::get() accepts impl IntoUrl and url::Url: IntoUrl, so the .to_string() call is an unnecessary allocation. Remove .to_string() and pass the Url directly. Same pattern may apply in other methods that construct URLs from Url::join.
